payoff: 'this what-if is not a maybe ... one day ... the green comes back on its own' states a future climate outcome as certain. The script's own source (University of Helsinki, Armstrong et al. 2023; its author's Conversation piece, Dec 2023) says the green periods did not happen during ice ages (high-latitude ice sheets suppressed them), so the 21,000-year wobble does not guarantee a green Sahara every cycle, and today's human-driven warming is a further unknown. Reword as what scientists expect, e.g. 'the wobble comes round about every 21,000 years, so scientists expect the rains to return one day, thousands of years from now', and drop 'not a maybe' and 'on its own'.

(minor, no change needed if kept) fact1 (more than 230 greenings in 8 million years) is not on the cited Helsinki news page; it is confirmed by Larrasoana, Roberts and Rohling, PLoS ONE 2013 (PMC3797788: 'over 230 GSPs within the last 8 million years') and by the Helsinki researcher Edward Armstrong in The Conversation (15 Dec 2023). Consider pointing fact1's url at the PLoS ONE paper or the Conversation article.
